effects.name: Spark
effects.description: Launch a spray of sparking Projectiles that travel erratically along the ground until they hit an enemy or expire. Consumes a Cold Infusion if possible to fire many sparks in a circle.

references.condition: Consuming a Cold Infusion

effects.name: Fireball
effects.description: Launch a large ball of Fire which explodes on impact. The explosion Consumes a Fire Infusion if possible to launch a ring of smaller firebolts.

references.condition: On projectile impact
If the explosion consumes a Fire Infusion

effects.name: Frostbolt
effects.description: Fire a slow-moving Piercing Projectile that is effective at Chilling enemies and explodes on colliding with terrain.

references.condition: On terrain collision

effects.name: Frost Darts
effects.description: Conjures a number of icy Projectiles that launch towards the target. Projectiles that Hit a Chilled or Frozen target create chunks of ice that deal additional damage on impacting the ground. Consumes a Cold Infusion if possible to cause each Projectile to lodge into the enemy then explode.

references.condition: Projectiles lodged in enemies after consuming a Cold Infusion explode
Projectiles hitting Chilled or Frozen targets create chunks that deal damage on ground impact

gem.BallLightning.name: Ball Lightning
gem.BallLightning.tagString: AoE, Projectile, Sustained, Lightning, Duration, Chaining, Repeatable

effects.name: Ball Lightning
effects.description: Fire a slow-moving Projectile that moves through enemies. The Projectile itself does not Hit enemies, but repeatedly discharges bolts of Lightning at nearby enemies. Consumes a Fire Infusion if possible to slow down over time, create Ignited Ground as it travels, and explode dealing Fire damage in an Area after it dissipates.

references.condition: After a Fire-Infused orb dissipates
Along the path of a Fire-Infused orb

effects.name: Arc
effects.description: An arc of Lightning stretches from the caster to a targeted enemy and Chains on to other nearby enemies. Consumes a Lightning Infusion if possible to deal more damage and Chain further.

effects.name: Ice Nova
effects.description: Conjure a wave of ice in all directions, Knocking Back enemies based on how close they are to you. Casting Ice Nova targeting near a Frostbolt Projectile will cause it to originate from the Frostbolt instead of you. Consumes a Cold Infusion if possible to leave a patch of Chilled Ground.

references.condition: When targeting near a Frostbolt Projectile, use the projectile as the origin
Consuming a Cold Infusion leaves Chilled Ground

effects.name: Boneshatter
effects.description: Attack enemies with a melee Strike. The Strike will cause a Heavy Stun on enemies that are Primed for Stun. Upon causing a Heavy Stun it will also create a Shockwave, dealing a large amount of damage in an area.

references.condition: On causing a Heavy Stun with the strike

effects.name: Earthquake
effects.description: Smash the ground, dealing damage in an area and leaving behind Jagged Ground that slows enemies. The Jagged Ground erupts in a powerful Aftershock after a duration. Cannot create Jagged Ground on top of an existing patch, or if you already have the maximum number of active patches.

references.condition: Jagged Ground erupts after its duration

effects.name: Rolling Slam
effects.description: Slam the ground to Stun enemies and knock them away, then continue forward and perform a devastating second Slam.

references.condition: Initial slam
Second slam after moving forward

effects.name: Molten Blast
effects.description: Gouge molten rock from the ground and fling it at the target. The Projectile explodes on collision, damaging enemies and scattering shrapnel in a cone behind it.

references.condition: Projectile collision scatters shrapnel behind the explosion

effects.name: Lightning Arrow
effects.description: Fire a charged arrow at the target. On hitting an enemy or wall, the arrow will fire Chaining Lightning beams at nearby enemies.

references.condition: Arrow hits an enemy or wall

effects.name: Ice Shot
effects.description: Fire an icy arrow that sprays a cone of ice shards when it hits a target.

references.condition: Arrow hits a target

effects.name: Poisonburst Arrow
effects.description: Fire a virulent arrow that creates a burst of Poison on hit, affecting all enemies in an area.

references.condition: Arrow hits a target

effects.name: Archmage
effects.description: While active, causes your Non-Channelling Spells to cost additional mana and deal extra Lightning damage, both based on your maximum Mana.

effects.name: Iron Ward
effects.description: While active, stores a percentage of the Physical damage that is prevented by your Armour or other sources of damage reduction. Using this Skill releases the stored damage as a nova of spikes.

references.condition: Using the skill releases the stored damage

effects.name: Arctic Armour
effects.description: While active, conjures an icy barrier that gains stages over time. While the barrier has stages, Melee Attacks that hit you will remove a stage to cause a burst of ice that deals Cold Spell damage to the attacker.

effects.name: Time of Need
effects.description: While active, periodically invokes divine blessings to heal you and remove Curses and Elemental Ailments from you.

gem.HeraldOfIce.name: Herald of Ice
gem.HeraldOfIce.tagString: Attack, Persistent, AoE, Cold, Herald, Payoff

effects.name: Herald of Ice
effects.description: While active, Shattering an enemy with a non-Herald Attack Hit will cause an icy explosion that deals Attack damage to surrounding enemies.

references.condition: While active, shatter an enemy with a non-Herald Attack Hit

effects.name: Herald of Ash
effects.description: While active, enemies you sufficiently Overkill with non-Herald Attacks will cause an explosion that Ignites nearby enemies based on the Overkill damage dealt.

references.condition: While active, sufficiently overkill an enemy with a non-Herald Attack

gem.HeraldOfThunder.name: Herald of Thunder
gem.HeraldOfThunder.tagString: Attack, Persistent, AoE, Lightning, Herald, Payoff

effects.name: Herald of Thunder
effects.description: While active, killing Shocked enemies with a non-Herald Attack Hit will cause subsequent Attack Hits to release lightning bolts which deals Attack damage to all surrounding enemies.

references.condition: Subsequent Attack Hits after killing a Shocked enemy with a non-Herald Attack Hit while active

effects.name: Cast on Critical
effects.description: While active, gains Energy when you Critically Hit enemies and triggers socketed Spells on reaching maximum Energy.

references.condition: Socketed spells trigger at maximum energy gained from critical hits while active

gem.CastOnElementalAilment.name: Cast on Elemental Ailment
gem.CastOnElementalAilment.tagString: Persistent, Trigger, Lightning, Cold, Fire, Meta

effects.name: Cast on Elemental Ailment
effects.description: While active, gains Energy when you Freeze, Shock, or Ignite enemies, and triggers socketed spells on reaching maximum Energy.

references.condition: Socketed spells trigger at maximum energy gained from freezing, shocking or igniting enemies while active

effects.name: Multishot I
effects.description: Supports Projectile skills, making them fire extra Projectiles. Also lowers Attack and Cast speed of supported skills, as well as lessening their damage.

effects.name: Chain I
effects.description: Supports Projectile skills and any other skills that Chain, causing them to Chain additional times.

effects.name: Fork
effects.description: Supports Projectile skills, making their Projectiles Fork.

effects.name: Pierce I
effects.description: Supports Projectile skills, making their Projectiles Pierce an enemy but deal less damage after doing so.

effects.name: Spell Echo
effects.description: Supports Cascadable Spells you use yourself. Supported Spells Echo.

effects.name: Unleash
effects.description: Supports Repeatable Spells you cast yourself, Sealing them over time. The Seals are broken when cast, each causing the Spell to Repeat. Cannot support skills with a Cooldown or which already gain Seals.

effects.name: Controlled Destruction
effects.description: Supports Spells that Hit enemies, boosting their damage but preventing them from dealing Critical Hits.

effects.name: Magnified Area I
effects.description: Supports any skill with an area of effect, making it larger.

effects.name: Concentrated Area
effects.description: Supports any skill with an area of effect, causing that area to be smaller but any area damage it deals to be higher.

effects.name: Pinpoint Critical
effects.description: Supports any skill that Hits Enemies, causing it to Critically Hit more often but deal less damage with Critical Hits.

effects.name: Brutality I
effects.description: Supports any skill that deals damage, boosting its Physical damage at the expense of all other Damage Types.

effects.name: Heavy Swing
effects.description: Supports Melee Attacks, boosting their Physical damage at the cost of Attack Speed.

effects.name: Fire Penetration I
effects.description: Supports any skill that Hits enemies, making those Hits Penetrate enemy Fire resistance.

effects.name: Cold Penetration
effects.description: Supports any skill that Hits enemies, making those Hits Penetrate enemy Cold resistance.

effects.name: Lightning Penetration
effects.description: Supports any skill that Hits enemies, making those Hits Penetrate enemy Lightning resistance.

effects.name: Deadly Herald
effects.description: Supports Herald Skills, making their triggered effects deal more damage at the expense of higher Spirit cost.

effects.name: Aftershock I
effects.description: Supports Slams you use yourself, giving them a chance to create an Aftershock.

effects.name: Fist of War I
effects.description: Supports Slams you use yourself, providing a powerful Ancestral Boost every few seconds.

effects.name: Rapid Casting I
effects.description: Supports Spells, causing them to cast faster.
